note: Crust — Water RL Supporter, Burst II, cd 20s, ammo 6 / reloadFrames 141 / chargeFrames 60 (datamine). STANCE-MODE MACHINE (mutually exclusive): her kit toggles between Maillard (entered in game by landing 3 normal non-Full-Charge attacks) and Blanching (entered by maintaining 3 Full Charges for >1 sec); each stance REMOVES the other. LOAD-BEARING PREMISE (verified sim.ts:3121 + probe 2026-07-31): the engine's RL/SR path ALWAYS fires full-charge shots (firePull(...,true) on every charge cycle; an RL never tap-fires), so the '3 normal non-Full-Charge → Maillard' entry can NEVER fire in-sim and Blanching is the ONLY reachable stance. The default mode is therefore BLANCHING (the sim-faithful state); a default run grants the burst's Sustained ▲10% and NEVER the Distributed ▲60%. Maillard is kept as a documented OPT-IN mode for modeling a real tap-fire / distributed-team playstyle (its buff payload — incl. the 60% Distributed burst — is real kit information), with the caveat that the sim's RL cadence full-charges regardless of the selected mode; selecting Maillard represents a player-behaviour override, not the sim's default cadence. The engine has no attack-pattern / stance-entry event primitive, so the live stance is a user-selectable `modes` pair [Blanching, Maillard]. Both stances grant the SAME S1 ATK buff (▲10% of caster ATK to all allies), so that line is unconditional across modes; only the burst's conditional damage buff discriminates the two stances. S1 STANCE ATK: 'ATK ▲10% of the skill user's ATK' = casterAtkPct 10 (a FLAT grant derived from the CASTER's staticAtk, identical absolute amount on every ally regardless of their own ATK — NOT atkPct which scales each target's own ATK). Modeled as a hitCount:3 trigger per stance (fires every 3 of crust's hits; RL hitsPerShot 1 ⇒ 3 full-charge shots ≈ 4.1s in, then re-procs every ~3 shots against the 10s window ⇒ saturated ~100% uptime after the opening proc); one mode-gated block per stance documents the two distinct entry conditions while the mode gate enforces their mutual exclusivity. The kit's '>1 sec maintain Full Charge' dwell qualifier is NOT modeled (the engine releases at full charge + release latency) — ⚑ convention: every sim full-charge shot counts as qualifying. S2 FB-ENTRY ATK: 'entering Full Burst → all targets in Maillard or Blanching → ATK ▲20% of the skill user's ATK /10s' = fullBurstEnter casterAtkPct 20 to all allies; a stance is always active (one of the two modes), so the 'in Maillard or Blanching' qualifier is ungated. BURST: 'all allies Attack Damage ▲20%/10s' = burstCast attackDamagePct 20 (ungated, lands on the cast frame BEFORE the FB window); 'all allies in Maillard Distributed Damage ▲60%/10s' = burstCast distributedDamagePct 60 mode-gated Maillard (feeds each ally's distributed-flavor hits ×1.6, sim.ts distributed bucket); 'all allies in Blanching Sustained Damage ▲10%/10s' = burstCast sustainedDamagePct 10 mode-gated Blanching (additive Damage-Up on sustained-flavor hits). The Distributed/Sustained buffs are granted to all allies but only move damage on distributed/sustained-flavor hits — inert at ×1 in comps without such hits (correct engine behaviour, not a gap). UNMODELED (all in `unmodeled`, no silent drops): S1 L1/L2 'Duration ▲2.5 sec' (a buff-duration-extension maintenance line — the stance ATK buff is modeled at saturated uptime, so extending its duration moves no damage; no generic duration-extend primitive); S1 'Removes Blanching'/'Removes Maillard' (mutual exclusivity enforced STRUCTURALLY by the single selected mode); S2 'Affects all allies not in Reliable Cooking status' (no-refresh gate — the engine has no 'apply only if absent' target filter; the model refreshes instead, inert while defPct is inert) and 'Removes 1 debuff' (no cleanse primitive; the scope-lock boss applies no ally debuffs). S2 RELIABLE COOKING DEF: 'DEF ▲10% of the skill user's DEF /10s' IS encoded as an inert defPct 10 block (hitCount:3, all allies, 10s) for kit completeness — ⚑ the kit is CASTER-DEF-derived but there is no casterDefPct StatKey, so it is approximated by the target's own defPct; defPct is inert for damage in v1 (self DEF does not feed own damage), so the approximation moves nothing today (a future DEF consumer would need a casterDefPct StatKey, not a retune). ⚑ MEASUREMENT-GATED: the full cadence tuple (charge 60 / reload 141) is a datamine estimate; stance-entry timing (first qualifying attack pattern, not t=0) and the '>1s maintain' dwell are folded into the hitCount:3 convention and unmeasured; which stance a real team holds is a player-behaviour choice the sim cannot auto-derive (pick the mode matching the recording). | Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-31: encoding authored test-first (scripts/tests/units/crust.test.ts) and reconciled cross-family — S1 stance ATK casterAtkPct 10 (hitCount:3, both stances, flat-from-caster discriminated vs atkPct), S2 Reliable Cooking defPct 10 (hitCount:3, inert), S2 FB-entry casterAtkPct 20 (fullBurstEnter, uncond), burst attackDamagePct 20 (burstCast, uncond), burst distributedDamagePct 60 (Maillard-gated), burst sustainedDamagePct 10 (Blanching-gated). S2b (claude-fable-5) verified the RL-always-full-charge premise ⇒ Blanching default; S5/S6 (claude-opus-5) blind re-derivations converged on modes [Blanching,Maillard], the casterAtkPct flat scaling, hitCount:3 stance trigger, inert defPct, fullBurstEnter S2, and the burstCast burst aura; corroboration recorded in scripts/kit-autonomy/results/crust.json.

skill1: Activates when attacking with Full Charge and self is in Maillard status. Affects all allies.
Activates when attacking with Full Charge and self is in Blanching status. Affects all allies.
skill2: Affects all allies not in Reliable Cooking status.

caveats: skill1: which stance (Blanching vs Maillard) is active is a user-selectable mode (default Blanching — the sim's RL always full-charges, sim.ts:3121, so Blanching is the only reachable stance; Maillard models the alternate tap-fire / distributed-team playstyle and overrides the sim's default cadence) — the stance-entry attack-pattern triggers (3 normal non-Full-Charge vs 3 Full Charges held >1s) are not simulated; pick the mode matching the real team's play pattern
skill1: the 'Duration ▲2.5 sec' lines are unmodeled — the stance ATK buff is modeled at saturated 100% uptime, so extending its duration moves no damage

skill2: the Reliable Cooking 'DEF ▲10% of the skill user's DEF' grant is encoded as an inert defPct 10 block (kit completeness) — the kit is caster-DEF-derived but no casterDefPct StatKey exists, so it is approximated by the target's own defPct; defPct is damage-inert in v1, so this moves nothing. The 'Removes 1 debuff' cleanse is unmodeled (no ally-debuff model); the 'allies not in Reliable Cooking' no-refresh gate is expressible via `noRetriggerWhileActive` (types.ts, vesti-tactical-upgrade precedent) but left unenacted — the gated grant is defPct, damage-inert in v1

burst: the Distributed Damage ▲60% (Maillard) and Sustained Damage ▲10% (Blanching) buffs are granted to all allies but only affect distributed-/sustained-flavor hits — inert in a comp without such hits
